subject.title: [Bug]: delivery-recovery 0 recovered / N failed after gateway restart — recovery starts before channel transport ready

question: Should Feishu outbound recovery be solved by a channel-owned reconnect drain, a generic gateway readiness gate, or a retry-reset policy at restart?
rationale: The source shows the remaining timing gap, but the permanent fix affects retry semantics and owner boundaries, and the reporter's local workaround includes broad behavior changes that are not safe to auto-apply without maintainer intent.

options.title: Add Feishu reconnect drain
options.body: Trigger the existing drainPendingDeliveries seam from Feishu WebSocket ready/reconnected events and preserve current retry accounting/backoff behavior.

options.title: Add generic readiness gate
options.body: Delay startup recovery behind a typed channel-readiness contract, which may be cleaner long term but touches broader gateway/channel startup semantics.

options.title: Reset retries on restart
options.body: Treat gateway restart as a retry boundary, but only if maintainers accept the risk of masking real repeated delivery failures.

recommendation.title: Add Feishu reconnect drain
recommendation.body: Trigger the existing drainPendingDeliveries seam from Feishu WebSocket ready/reconnected events and preserve current retry accounting/backoff behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: He is tied to both the shared outbound recovery split and Feishu transport lifecycle history, while the decision crosses plugin and gateway recovery boundaries.
